origin.description: Reads a Stata .dta file into a tibble.
origin.usage: read_dta(file, encoding = NULL, col_select = NULL, skip = 0, n_max = Inf, .name_repair = "unique")

arguments.name: file
arguments.text: A path or the raw bytes of the file.

arguments.name: encoding
arguments.text: Character encoding. Needed mainly for Stata 13 and earlier.

arguments.name: col_select
arguments.text: Column names or 1-based positions to keep.

arguments.name: n_max
arguments.text: Maximum rows to read. Inf, NA, and a negative number read every row.

origin.details: Dates become Date, datetimes become POSIXct in UTC, and labelled columns keep their labels. The file label and notes are attributes of the table. col_select accepts names or positions.
origin.value: A tibble. write_dta returns the input data.
origin.example:
path <- "/home/ahmed/R/library/haven/examples/iris.dta"
d <- read_dta(path, col_select = "species")
cat(nrow(d), names(d), d$species[1], "\n")
